description: Unit a TextDiff comparison works on. Word level compares word, number and punctuation tokens (so a re-flowed paragraph is not a change); line level compares whole lines including their line break.

members.name: Words
members.description: Word, number and punctuation tokens. Whitespace is not a token of its own.

members.name: Lines
members.description: Whole lines, so every difference is a whole-line insertion, deletion or replacement.
